reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Balance sheet insolvency standard
headings.reviewNote: Defines debtor insolvency as debts exceeding fair valuation of assets.

headings.title: Presumption of insolvency from nonpayment
headings.reviewNote: Establishes rebuttable presumption of insolvency for debtor generally not paying debts as they become due.

headings.title: Partnership insolvency standard
headings.reviewNote: Establishes partnership insolvency based on debts exceeding partnership assets plus net assets of general partners.

headings.title: Assets excluded from insolvency determination
headings.reviewNote: Excludes property transferred, concealed, or removed with intent to hinder, delay, or defraud creditors or transferred in a manner voidable under sections 428.005 to 428.059.

headings.title: Debts excluded from insolvency determination
headings.reviewNote: Excludes obligations to the extent secured by valid liens on excluded property.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and 1992 enactment note; retained titles and removed unstated 'exempt property' reference from subsection 4 note on assets excluded from insolvency calculations.

headings.title: Definition of value for transfer or obligation
headings.reviewNote: Defines value as transfer of property or securing or satisfying antecedent debt, excluding unperformed executory promises.

headings.title: Reasonably equivalent value through foreclosure or enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Deems reasonably equivalent value given when interest is acquired through noncollusive, regular foreclosure sale.

headings.title: Contemporaneous exchange for present value
headings.reviewNote: Defines present value transfer where exchange is intended and substantially contemporaneous.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1992 enactment note; confirmed UFTA value definition, noncollusive foreclosure reasonably equivalent value, and contemporaneous exchange for present value.

headings.title: Fraudulent transfers as to present and future creditors
headings.reviewNote: Defines fraudulent transfers based on actual intent to defraud or unreasonably small assets without equivalent value.

headings.title: Badges of fraud indicating actual intent
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates nonexclusive factors for evaluating debtor actual intent to hinder, delay, or defraud creditors.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections (including eleven actual-intent factors), 1992 history, and 2004 annotation (Fischer v. Brancato, 147 S.W.3d 794) on UFTA recovery without pleading veil piercing; confirmed headings.

headings.title: Constructive fraud as to present creditors
headings.reviewNote: Renders transfer fraudulent without equivalent value if debtor was insolvent or became insolvent thereby.

headings.title: Insider transfers for antecedent debt
headings.reviewNote: Renders transfer fraudulent if made to insider for antecedent debt while debtor was insolvent and insider had reasonable cause to believe insolvency.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1992 enactment note; confirmed constructive fraud as to present creditors and insolvent insider antecedent-debt transfers.

headings.title: Creditor remedies against fraudulent transfers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes avoidance of transfers, attachment, injunctions against disposition, appointment of receivers, and other equitable relief.

headings.title: Execution levy on transferred asset or proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Permits judgment creditor to levy execution on transferred assets or proceeds by court order.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1992 enactment note; confirmed creditor avoidance, attachment, injunction, and receiver remedies plus court-ordered execution levy on transferred assets or proceeds.

headings.title: Good faith and equivalent value defense
headings.reviewNote: Bars transfer avoidance under actual intent provisions against good-faith transferees giving reasonably equivalent value.

headings.title: Recovery of judgment against transferee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes money judgment against first transferee or subsequent bad-faith transferee to extent transfer is voidable.

headings.title: Asset valuation timing for money judgment
headings.reviewNote: Requires money judgment to be based on asset value at time of transfer subject to equitable adjustment.

headings.title: Good-faith transferee protections and lien rights
headings.reviewNote: Accords good-faith transferee lien rights, enforcement rights, or reduction in liability to extent of value given.

headings.title: Non-voidable lease termination and lien enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Precludes avoidance of commercially reasonable lease terminations or enforcement of security interests under article 9.

headings.title: Defenses to insider transfers
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates safe harbor defenses for insider transfers involving new value, ordinary course of business, or good-faith rehabilitation.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections and 1992 enactment note; confirmed good-faith transferee defenses, money judgment limits/valuation, transferee lien rights, lease/Article 9 safe harbors, and insider-transfer defenses.

headings.title: Definitions of court, filing officer, and nonconsensual lien
headings.reviewNote: Defines statutory terms including court, filing officer, and nonconsensual common law lien.

headings.title: Non-creation of substantive lien rights
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that provisions create no property lien or interest not otherwise existing under law.

headings.title: Limitation on municipal court authority
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that municipal courts are not authorized to create property liens or interests.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1996 enactment note; confirmed court, filing officer, and nonconsensual common law lien definitions and non-creation of substantive or municipal-court lien rights.

headings.title: Rejection of nonconsensual common law liens
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes filing officers to reject nonconsensual common law liens while protecting authorized filings.

headings.title: Sworn notice of invalid lien filing and notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides for filing and mailing sworn notice of invalid lien and shields filing officers from liability.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1996 enactment note; confirmed permissive rejection of nonconsensual common law liens (with authorized-filer exceptions) and mandatory acceptance/mailing of sworn Notice of Invalid Lien with immunity.

headings.title: Mandatory appearance warning in show-cause order
headings.reviewNote: Requires show-cause order to warn that nonappearance results in lien voidness and fee award.

headings.title: Judicial determination of invalidity and release order
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to declare nonconsensual lien void ab initio, release lien, and award costs and fees.

headings.title: Judicial determination of lien validity and fee award
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes order confirming lien validity and permitting costs and reasonable attorney fees.

headings.title: Filing certified order with recording officer
headings.reviewNote: Requires circuit clerk to file certified copy of court order with appropriate filing officer.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1996 enactment note; confirmed show-cause appearance warning, void ab initio release with mandatory fees, validity confirmation with permissive fees, and certified-order filing.
